description: Market trials: every trading rule OPSIN has switched on and off on a live market against a coin flip (preregistered before its trades existed, signed once they played out), newest first; what the last day's launches on Elysium, the first market the lab reads, did in their first hour; and the rules OPSIN designs itself, one change at a time, each measured on new launches against the rule it came from.
name: opsin_markets
